pages.text: Dingding left shoes on the paddy bank. A leaf floated down one level, then another.
Water carried one shoe away. "My shoe!" Dingding wanted it back.
Grandma took Dingding's hand. "Floating things all gather in the pool. Come."
She went into the next valley. The old pool was now a field, with green onions in rows.
She looked around. "It was here. Where did it go?"
No shoe, no water in the field. Only Dingding's feet got dirty.
Grandma walked round it. "Where has the water moved?"
Dingding returned to the paddies. The leaf still went down level by level. "Water only goes down!"
Down went Dingding, one level at a time. Three below, the shoe caught in grass.
Water filled it. Dingding tipped it, and a tiny fish dropped out!
